title: A duality-preserving extension of the Worley-Sagan insertion and Haiman's mixed insertion for the hyperoctahedral group
summary: The Worley-Sagan insertion and Haiman's mixed insertion are insertion algorithms for shifted Young tableaux, and each of them gives a Robinson-Schensted-type correspondence between the symmetric group of degree $n$ and a set consisting of certain pairs of same-shape shifted Young tableaux with $n$ cells. It is a known fact that these two insertions are dual to each other. Our purpose is to give an extension of these two insertions without losing the duality relationship.
